notes: The tool texts the tool-search case file is generated from. They are hand-written but mirror real MCP servers: the names, servers and hints follow what agent/mcp builds from a server's ListTools (SearchHint = server + name parts + description keywords, summary = the description's first line). It is a FIXTURE, not the user's pool: a noul question is judged per (request, tool) pair, so what a calibration depends on is the STYLE of the two texts, not which pool they came from. Re-run the sweep against a real pool when one is configured — that is a one-command re-check, and it is the honest way to move the threshold afterwards.
